title: The gutters
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The college's gutters overflow onto Lot C's walkway. A river between the car and the door. Wood carries the dog across. The guard carries Wood's pad. Nobody planned this.

panels.composition: Lot C, water running from the roof's gutters across the walkway in a sheet, the building's door on the far side. WOOD and BARNABY at the water's edge.

image.prompt: a college parking lot walkway flooded by water pouring from overflowing gutters, a young man and a small dog stopped at the edge, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood lifting the dog under one arm. The pad in the other hand. Looking at the water.

image.prompt: a young man holding a small dog under one arm and a drawing pad in the other hand, facing a sheet of runoff, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The GUARD, appearing, taking the pad from him without a word. Wood stepping in. Water to the ankle.

image.prompt: a security guard taking a drawing pad from a young man who is wading into shallow water with a dog under his arm, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The far side. The guard handing the pad back dry. The dog handed down. Wood's shoes ruined. The guard's too. Nobody says thanks; nobody has to.

image.prompt: a security guard returning a dry drawing pad to a soaked young man setting a small dog down on a doorstep, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: The guard carries the pad. Nobody planned it. Nobody says thanks.
